title: Initiative impact mapping and capacity slices to align company OKRs across teams
creator: Asha Patel
description: Create an operational playbook and artifact set that maps company-level OKRs to a set of initiative impact maps and capacity slices. Objective is to make cross-functional commitments explicit: what product work, infra investment, and design effort are required per OKR, and how trade-offs are resolved when capacity is constrained. Deliverables: 1) Initiative impact map template with RACI + success metrics, 2) Capacity slice model (engineering/design/product) for quarterly planning, 3) Rollup dashboard for leadership to track commitment drift.
updates: 2025-11-02 | Asha Patel: Kickoff with GTM, Eng, Design. Collected OKR owners and initial lists of candidate initiatives. Agreed scope: company-level OKRs for FY26 Q1-Q2 only.

2025-11-04 | Miguel Ramirez: Drafted Initiative Impact Map template (Confluence linked). Template includes: business objective, success metrics, effort estimate bands, primary owner, dependent teams, and rollback criteria.

2025-11-06 | Claire Donovan (Design): Added UX/Design effort bands and suggested measurable UX signals. Trade-off noted: measuring UX signals will require +2 weeks of instrumentation on Console dashboards; marked as dependency.

2025-11-07 | Ravi Singh (Eng): Proposed Capacity Slices model based on team allocation percentages (Core Runtime, Platform, Console, Infra). Simulated three scenarios (optimistic/neutral/constrained) using historical throughput of dev cycles. Link to simulation CSV in Drive.

2025-11-08 | Miguel Ramirez: Ran a tabletop with Eng leads to map top 12 initiatives into slices. Outcome: 4 initiatives spill into multiple slices and need explicit cross-team spikes. Created ENG spikes: ENG-6274, ENG-6820.

2025-11-09 | Asha Patel: Presented draft to Exec Review. Feedback: require clearer rollback criteria and a compact one-page commitment summary for exec commit. Action: produce 1-page commitment card for each OKR by 2025-11-15.

2025-11-11 | Miguel Ramirez: Created initial rollup dashboard prototype in Grafana to surface planned vs. committed capacity and risk level per initiative. Data sources: JIRA velocity, on-call burn, and Dedicated capacity forecasts. Dashboard link: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/okrs-rollup

2025-11-12 | Decision: Adopt 3-tier commitment model (Committed, Contingent, Backlog). Trade-off: Contingent items allowed to start but deprioritized if blocking work emerges. Approved by PM, Eng, Design leads. Follow-ups: update roadmap view and release gates to reflect tiers (assigned to ENG-4822).
notes: Key trade-offs: precision vs. agility. Higher precision (tight resource accounting) increases overhead; chosen compromise is 3-tier model with quarterly rebalancing.
Linked artifacts: PRD in Drive, Impact Map template in Confluence, Dashboard prototype in Grafana, and an initial GitHub PR for the roadmap docs (see attachments).
Next major milestones: 1) Produce one-page commitment cards (due 2025-11-15), 2) Run cross-team capacity allocation workshop (2025-11-20), 3) Publish final rollup to Exec (2025-11-30).
